sentences.en: Almost everything that is great has been done by youth.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有的伟大成就都是由年轻人完成的。

sentences.en: We are still clinging to the dreams of our youth.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然坚守着青春的梦想。

sentences.en: My nephew was excused on the grounds of his youth.
sentences.zh: 我的侄子因为年轻被豁免了。

senses.zh: 青年时期, 青春(期) - 青春, 活力, 朝气, 血气 - 青年人 - 年轻人, 青年男子
